label: Gambling & Betting Scams
description: Rigged casinos, fake sportsbooks, tipster cons and betting-recovery scams that take stakes and winnings.

label: Bereavement & Inheritance Scams
description: Fake inheritances, funeral-cost cons, obituary phishing and estate-fee scams that exploit grief and loss.

label: Benefits & Welfare Scams
description: Fake benefit applications, grant approvals, rebate texts and reactivation cons that harvest data and fees.

label: Faith & Religious Scams
description: Prosperity-gospel investments, fake tithing portals, pilgrimage cons and clergy-impersonation scams.

label: Ticket & Event Scams
description: Fake concert, festival and sports tickets, duplicate barcodes and resale cons that leave you locked out.

label: Adult & Creator-Platform Scams
description: Creator-economy and adult-platform cons: fake subscriptions, payout-verification fees and management scams.

label: Finance Scams
description: Investment, crypto, loan, pension and recovery scams designed to take your money and then take it again.

label: Online Shopping Scams
description: Fake stores, fake delivery texts, counterfeit goods and non-delivery scams that take payment and vanish.

label: Romance & Relationship Scams
description: Emotional manipulation used to extract money, often blended with crypto investment grooming.

label: Job & Income Scams
description: Fake recruiters, task scams, work-from-home traps and pay-to-get-paid schemes targeting job seekers.

label: Travel Scams
description: Fake booking sites, hotel phishing, fake visa services and rental scams aimed at travellers.

label: Government Impersonation Scams
description: Fake tax, police, immigration and court demands using fear and urgency to force payment.

label: Tech Scams
description: Fake support calls, phishing, malware popups, QR-code and remote-access scams.

label: AI-Era Scams
description: Deepfake voices, cloned websites, AI trading bots and synthetic endorsements raising the stakes.

label: Business Scams
description: Invoice redirection, CEO fraud, business email compromise and fake suppliers targeting organisations.

label: Health & Medical Scams
description: Fake pharmacies, miracle cures, bogus health insurance and medical identity theft that risk your money and health.

label: Housing & Rental Scams
description: Fake rental listings, deposit theft, foreclosure-relief fraud, moving-company scams and real-estate wire fraud.

label: Crypto & Web3 Scams
description: Rug pulls, wallet drainers, fake airdrops, seed-phrase phishing and bogus staking that exploit irreversible crypto.

label: Lottery & Prize Scams
description: Fake lottery wins, prize notifications and sweepstakes that demand an upfront fee for a prize that doesn't exist.

label: Charity & Disaster Scams
description: Fake charities, disaster-relief appeals and bogus crowdfunding that exploit generosity, especially after tragedies.

label: Utility & Energy Scams
description: Fake shut-off threats, bogus energy brokers, solar and rebate scams that impersonate your utility company.

label: Auto & Vehicle Scams
description: Fake vehicle listings, escrow and shipping fraud, VIN cloning, title washing and bogus extended warranties.

label: Telecom & Account Scams
description: SIM swapping, number porting, account takeover and hacked-friend scams that hijack your phone and logins.

label: Insurance Scams
description: Fake health, auto, life and travel insurance, ghost brokers, and bogus claims-settlement schemes.

label: Education & Student Scams
description: Student-loan-forgiveness, scholarship, diploma-mill, tuition-payment and study-abroad scams.

label: Gaming Scams
description: Free-currency generators, account takeovers, fake marketplaces and item-trading scams targeting players.

label: Identity Theft & Data Scams
description: Synthetic identity, account-opening fraud, credential theft and data-breach exploitation that hijack who you are.

label: Mail & Courier Fraud
description: Courier 'card collection' fraud, mail theft, check washing and parcel-redelivery scams that exploit post and deliveries.

label: Legal & Immigration Scams
description: Fake visa, green-card and legal services, deportation-threat extortion and bogus settlement or lawsuit claims.

label: Subscription & Billing Scams
description: Negative-option billing, free-trial traps, cramming and hard-to-cancel subscriptions that drain accounts quietly.

label: Pet & Animal Scams
description: Puppy-deposit and fake-breeder scams, escalating pet-shipping fees, and bogus adoption or lost-pet schemes.

label: MLM, Pyramid & Hustle Scams
description: Recruitment-only pyramid schemes, product-based MLM traps, gifting circles and 'passive income' hustle schemes.

label: Social Media & Account Takeover
description: Verification-badge phishing, hacked-friend impersonation, account-recovery cons and content-monetization traps.

label: Home Services & Contractor Scams
description: Door-to-door and contractor cons — driveway paving, storm-chaser roofing, fake locksmiths, and disappearing-deposit handymen.

label: Extortion & Blackmail Scams
description: Sextortion-spam emails, intimate-image blackmail, ransom-DDoS and doxxing threats that demand payment for silence.

label: Imposter & Emergency Scams
description: Grandparent and family-emergency cons, fake-boss gift-card requests, and 'your relative is in trouble' calls that manufacture panic.

label: Street & In-Person Scams
description: Classic confidence tricks and street cons run face to face — three-card monte, the pigeon drop, change-raising, distraction theft, and tourist-targeted scams.

label: Payment Card & ATM Fraud
description: Physical and digital theft of card data — ATM and gas-pump skimmers, chip shimmers, card cloning, and web-skimming (Magecart) checkout attacks.
